## Agent Instructions

```text
At Step 0-Ref, before creating any test case:
1. Read this file to get the URL list and folder paths for this project
2. Fetch each configured URL using fetch_webpage
3. Scan each configured folder path for .md, .docx, .pdf files matching the story feature area
4. Extract: field definitions, expected behaviours, API response formats, valid test data values
5. Use extracted content as authoritative reference — it overrides assumptions in expected results
6. Log: "[Ref] Help link: {label} ({url}) — {N} relevant sections extracted"
7. Log: "[Ref] Folder: {label} ({path}) — {N} relevant files found"

If a configured URL redirects to a login page or returns restricted content, log:
"[Ref] ⚠️ Restricted page: {url} — using accessible docs + story evidence; request authenticated excerpt if needed"
```

**Priority order for expected results** (highest to lowest):

1. Swagger/OpenAPI spec (exact response format)
2. Product Help Portal (user-visible expected behaviour)
3. knowledge-base feature docs (internal design intent)
4. Shared doc folder files (supplementary context)
5. Story ACs (baseline — used when none of the above is available)

Boundary rule for CID Hub stories:

- Do not add speculative test steps outside story AC/Design Notes/QA Notes.
- Derive registration-link and expected-behavior assertions from the configured CID docs URL first.
